title: Serpent Apothecary
description: A blue-skinned witch with long green hair and red floral adornments stands behind an ornate blue apothecary table inside an icy cave. She raises one hand while a large white serpent with glowing patterns and hanging ornaments coils ethereally above her amid green magical energy.
prompt: A mystical blue-skinned witch with flowing green hair and red flowers stands in an icy cavern lit by moonlight, raising her hand as a large luminous white serpent coils gracefully above her with hanging golden ornaments. An ornate blue apothecary table in front holds potion bottles, scrolls tied with red ribbons, a bowl of herbs, and a glowing red lantern. Red fabric drapes from icy arches, green magical energy swirls in the air, winter night atmosphere, detailed digital fantasy art
